answer: Bind each new identity to a unique hardware key sealed inside a secure enclave, so one machine can vouch for only one agent no matter how many keypairs it spawns — a grove of clones grown from a single ivory tower of silicon still shares one root. The failure mode is a farmer renting a fleet of cheap devices, so the check is to sample new identities each epoch, compare their hardware attestations, and freeze any cluster whose keys trace back to one bulk purchase or one pearl of a supply chain.
